title: Waltzes, quadrilles, dance contests and Scott Joplin rags in the 1920s
summary: A long garbled block: Lewis discusses unrecorded New Orleans musicians, playing for dance organizations, waltz contests, Prohibition ending the clubs, ragtime tunes, non-reading players and bassist Buddy Luck.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
